semanticKind.description: The current strict view supplies this on every node. An eager Yield whose tail is still computing is an operation; Candidate is uncommitted Search data.

owners.description: Introduction groups on the source node that owns them, in source order. Preserve empty groups and hidden source identities. Hidden source IDs must not select a visible source expression. These groups do not replace the node id or stateId.

vars.description: Introduced variables encoded as visible terms; an empty array is a retained empty group.
